ctx.x: Well, one time I heard him in a speakeasy. It was on Domaine and Robinson. He came down to Buck Willie. Little Willie. Because all the piano players from all parts of town would look Willie up when they thought that he was strong enough, you see. And they tell me him and Willie tied up there for a while, now came in on the last of it. I heard about two, three numbers that he played. He was a nice piano player. Who won? Well, everybody was playing for Willie. Willie had the reputation at that time. I think that…
Was he who was it? Buzzy Williams, another white pianist?
He was Kid Ross's roommate. Yeah. I don't know if you know him. I don't know him.
